verdict.rationale: Mastra is a code-first TypeScript framework that runs without a UI. Its docs say it runs on Node.js, Bun, Deno, or Cloudflare, can be deployed as a server, and can fire workflows or agents on a cron schedule, so unattended automation is documented. However, recurring cron schedules are not the same as on-demand CI invocation, and the pack has no CI-specific guidance. missing for 10: documented CI pipeline usage (e.g. GitHub Actions or running scorers/evals in CI), a headless CLI run command with exit codes, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Mastra can run against any of these runtime environments: - Node.js `v22.13.0` or later - Bun - Deno - Cloudflare
You can deploy a Mastra server or integrate with an existing web framework.
Declare a `schedule` field on a workflow and Mastra will fire it on the cron you specify.
A schedule runs an agent on a cron cadence.
